content:
Late-summer AirPods sale bonanza is in full swing. Even though we're potentially just one month away from a new generation landing and even potential price drops on those, AirPods Pro 3 are now at the best price ever, AirPods 4 with ANC just dropped to near the lowest price in six months, and the brand new AirPods Max 2 from 2026 are now down $120.

In less than a month, Apple will very likely debut its new generation of in-ear personal listening devices, but the company did kick off the year with an upgrade for its over-ear headphones in the form of the all-new AirPods Max 2, and they're now at the best price yet.

  • AirPods Pro 3 for $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 for $429 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC for $135 (originally $179) — best price in 6 months
  • AirPods 4 for $99 (originally $129)

Amazon is currently selling AirPods Max 2 for $429 shipped, down from $549 for a $120 discount and one of the best prices we've seen since launch. We did see a brief $399 deal during Prime Day but inventory and color options were scarce.

Best Buy has all five colors at the discounted price right now, as part of its big 60th anniversary sale that kicked off earlier this morning; Amazon will likely follow suit shortly.

  • All colors of AirPods Max 2 for $429 (originally $549)

Apple finally delivered what amounts to a true next-generation upgrade for AirPods Max earlier this year, and when we'll see a third model remains to be seen. The previous version was largely considered an AirPods Max 1.5 by many, swapping in a new exterior look and USB-C port; but this year's Max 2 delivers a major spec bump, including a high dynamic range amplifier and Apple H2 chip-driven listening experience — up to 1.5x better active noise cancellation, plus new "digital signal processing algorithms" for improved Transparency mode.

We detailed all of the upgrades already, but here's a quick recap from Apple:

  • Adaptive Audio: Automatically adjusts the intensity of active noise cancellation and Transparency mode based on the user's environment for an optimized listening experience.
  • Conversation Awareness: Automatically reduces media volume and minimizes background noise when the user starts speaking to someone nearby.
  • Live Translation: Powered by Apple Intelligence, this feature helps users communicate face-to-face in different languages.
  • Voice Isolation: Uses advanced computational audio powered by the H2 chip to prioritize the user's voice during calls while blocking out ambient noise.
  • Camera Remote: Users can remotely capture a photo or start and stop video recording by pressing the digital crown while using the Camera app or compatible third-party camera apps on iPhone or iPad.
  • Studio-Quality Audio Recording: Enables journalists, podcasters, singers, and other creators to record content with higher audio quality and a more natural vocal texture.
  • Loud Sound Reduction: Helps users avoid exposure to loud environmental noises while preserving the tonal qualities of what they're listening to.
  • Personalized Volume: Automatically fine-tunes the listening experience based on the user's long-term preferences.
  • Siri Interactions: Lets users respond to Siri prompts conveniently and privately with a simple nod for "yes" or a shake of the head for "no".
